justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/javadoc/{JavadocFormatter.java,JavadocLexer.java,JavadocWriter.java,CharStream.java,NestingCounter.java,Token.java}, plus core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/JavaCommentsHelper.java and core/src/test/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/JavadocFormattingTest.java. The package has 6 classes and 1,420 total LOC, but they form one narrow Javadoc-formatting pipeline (lexer -> token model -> writer -> formatter) with one public entry point; the other classes are small helpers. Its only observed production consumer is JavaCommentsHelper, so it is cohesive rather than an excessively broad God Component.
